      26. Revenue                                                                        26、收入
            The Group recognises revenue based on the transaction price                      本集團在履行了合同中的履約義務，
            allocated to such performance obligation when a performance                      即在客戶取得相關商品或服務控制權
            obligation is satisfied, i.e. when “control” of the goods or services            時，按照分攤至該項履約義務的交易
            underlying the particular performance obligation is transferred to               價格確認收入。履約義務，是指合同
            the customer. A performance obligation represents the commitment                 中本集團向客戶轉讓可明確區分商品
            that a good or service that is distinct shall be transferred by the              或服務的承諾。交易價格，是指本集
            Group to the customer. Transaction price refers to the amount                    團因向客戶轉讓商品或服務而預期有
            of consideration to which the Group expects to be entitled in                    權收取的對價金額，但不包含代第三
            exchange of transferring goods or services to a customer, excluding              方收取的款項以及本集團預期將退還
            the amount received on behalf of third parties and the amount that               給客戶的款項。
            the Group expects to return to a customer.


            On the inception date of the contract, the Group evaluates                       本集團在合同開始日對合同進行評
            the contract to identify the individual performance obligations                  估，識別該合同所包含的各單項履約
            contained in the contract, and determines whether each individual                義務，並確定各單項履約義務是在某

            The Group organises and manages its operating business in                    本集團的經營業務根據業務的性質以

      EMOLUMENT POLICY                                                                      薪酬政策
      The Group is strictly in compliance with laws and regulations such as the Labour      本集團認真貫徹落實中國《勞動法》、《勞動合同
      Law and the Labour Contract Law of the PRC, and formulates a remuneration             法》等法律法規，並結合企業發展戰略、行業特
      system and incentive policies that suit the actual situation of the enterprise by     點和人工成本支付能力，制定切合企業實際的薪
      combining the development strategy of the enterprise, the characteristics of the      酬制度和激勵政策。
      industry and the ability to pay for labour costs.


      The Group adopts a differentiated and standardised annual salary system               本集團根據管理、研發、生產工人等不同崗位序
      and a non-annual salary system according to different job positions such as           列，分別採取差異化、規範化的年薪制和非年薪
      management, research and development and production, where the non-annual             制薪酬制度，其中非年薪制又細分為崗位績效工
      salary system is subdivided into salary systems such as performance-based salary      資制、計（時）件工資制、班產量日工資制度等薪
      system, piece-rate (hourly) salary system and shift production daily salary system.   酬制度。


      By evaluating the position value of all kinds of personnel and referencing the        通過對各類人員進行崗位價值評估和對標市場薪
      market remuneration level, we have set the salary standard with competitive           酬水平，制定具備競爭優勢的薪酬標準，合理
      advantages by reasonably setting the salary level hierarchy of personnel,             設定人員薪酬等級層級，確定以崗定薪級、以績
      determining the salary level by position and the salary distribution plan by          效定薪酬分配方案，並依據績效考評實施薪酬升
